response.text:
I can send that, but I need your explicit confirmation before I send any email (sending is an externally visible action). Please confirm the details below or tell me any changes:

- Recipient: vendor@example.com
- Message body: We accept the revised price and authorize production.
- Subject (suggested): "Authorization to Proceed" — confirm or give a different subject.
- Signature: none by default — reply with the name to include, or say "no signature."

Reply with one of:
- "Send now, subject: [subject], signature: [name]" or
- "Send now, no signature" or
- Any edits you want before sending.
